_comment: Scenario 1 — Slack bot token present and valid. Slack bot tokens do not expire — token_expiry_seconds is null. Token revocation is the only path to needs_auth.
Scenario 2 — Slack bot token revoked (workspace admin removed app, or app uninstalled). Slack-specific revocation via auth.revoke API added in T1-S12-C — local deletion only in Sprint 10.
